name: ipdata
tagline: IP geolocation with threat intel, ASN, currency, and timezone
description: ipdata is a self-serve IP geolocation API that returns location, ASN, currency, timezone, and threat intelligence for IP addresses. Developers call a single HTTPS endpoint with an API key; free daily allowance is available for low-volume use.

auth.details: API key via api-key query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup

use_cases: geolocate an IP address for personalization
check if an IP is a known threat or proxy
get ASN and organization for an IP
resolve currency and timezone from IP
